column1: # Which language a message is answered in (roadmap 1.4).
# Every other file declares the language of each row, so none of them exercises detection: a row in
# Swedish is planned in Swedish whatever the detector would have said. Here `lang` is what the
# detector must decide, and expect_intent is the pseudo-intent LANGUAGE. A session starts in English,
# the app's default, and each turn starts from the language the turn before was answered in, as a
# conversation does; a turn with no evidence of a language must keep it.
# Both platforms detected language from element names alone, so a question that names no element
# carried no signal at all: "hur många ädelgaser finns det" was answered in English.
# ---- no element name: the language itself is the only evidence ----------------------------------
